LLM auditresponse for 02_install_ec_axb35_dkms.sh:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The script `02_install_ec_axb35_dkms.sh` is designed to install a kernel module via DKMS with MOK (Machine Owner Key) signing for Secure Boot compatibility. It performs standard operations expected in such a setup: checking for root privileges, resolving the repository root, validating the presence of MOK keys, installing required build dependencies (dkms, build-essential, linux-headers), cleaning up any previous DKMS installations, copying source files, generating a `dkms.conf`, and building/installing the module via DKMS.
